name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance in Rent to MSEs
benefit: - **Quantum of Assistance:** 70 % of rent paid by the enterprise with a maximum limit of ₹1,00,000/- per annum for 5 years.
_eligibility_text:
1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise run by SC/ST entrepreneur.
   1. The applicant must be a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) engaged in manufacturing activities.
   1. The enterprise must be operating from a legally rented/leased shed.
   1. The rented/leased shed’s owner must have legal ownership and possession of the property.
   1. The manufacturing unit must be consuming electricity/power for production activities.

&gt; **Note****:** 

  - **SC/ST Enterprise:** SC/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more.
